title: kate-ui: follow the system theme
summary: The window reads the appearance and picks Breeze Light or Breeze Dark through cache::theme_name. A View menu offers Light, Dark, and System. The theme JSON files of kate-syntax are included at build time. The colors and the shaped line cache refresh on a change.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. session.rs imports GPUI, the crate builds only on macOS, and the owner looks at the window after the change.

definitions.definition:
/// The theme JSON for a theme name from cache::theme_name.
fn theme_json(name: &str) -> &'static str

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Store a cache::ThemeChoice on WindowRoot, default System. On open and on a window appearance change, compute theme_name(choice, dark) where dark is window.appearance() Dark or VibrantDark, build Theme::from_json(theme_json(name)), store it on workspace.theme, recompute colors_from_theme, and clear the shaped line cache. theme_json returns the breeze-dark.theme text for Breeze Dark and the breeze-light.theme text otherwise, both via include_str from ../../kate-syntax/themes. The three menu actions set the choice and refresh. The test theme_json_matches_the_name asserts theme_json("Breeze Dark") contains "Breeze Dark" and theme_json("Breeze Light") contains "Breeze Light". The owner switches the system appearance and the window follows. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::theme_json_matches_the_name
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because theme_json does not exist. After the change each name returns the JSON of that theme.
